meta.description:
A one-storey instrument-house arranged around a square lantern court, where a narrow entry passage opens into branching chambers for study, stargazing, storage, and ritual craft.
    The building feels like a cross between an observatory and a living mechanical organ, with a deliberate procession from compressed threshold to luminous center and quieter peripheral rooms.

rooms.name: The Compressed Threshold
rooms.style: A narrow entry gallery that feels intentionally compressed before the building opens up, furnished with ribbed arches, faceted benches, and dark polished stone forms suggesting a ceremonial instrument case.
